facts.fact: The article says Primary Leaving Examination results from the National Examination Board have been imported into DHIS2-DEMIS, the decentralised EMIS piloted in 10 of 175 administrative sites, for analysis by district and school.
facts.system: DHIS2-DEMIS import of UNEB PLE results
